title: Learning Mexican music as a non-reading drummer and band manager
summary: Playing the Southwest meant Mexican, hillbilly and jazz; Williams, who could not read, picked up Mexican music by ear and impressed the local musicians.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
